body:
I am male in my early twenties living in a small country in south eastern Europe. I have been always interested in psychoactive drugs but despite this my list of psychoactive drugs that I have done so far is modest consisting of alcohol, caffeine, nicotin and over the counter painkillers containing paracetamol and codeine.
Since Bromazepam can be freely bought in any pharmacy without prescription in my country,  I decided to buy one pack of 30,  6 mg pills (they are very cheap, the whole pack is around 1 euro) and to try them from sheer curiosity.
For a start I split one 6 mg pill in half (it is better to be safe than sorry) and ingested it on empty stomach. Only about 15 minutes later I felt that my arms were getting kind a heavy and my legs felt a bit unsure. As the time went on I  was getting kind a calm and slightly indifferent of things happening around me. However the whole thing wasnt  so  special, so decided that the next time I will take 6 mg.
One week later I had free day and decided to further my self experimentation with  Bromazepam . On empty stomach I took one whole pill(6 mg). As the first time about 15 minutes later  my limbs got heavy, and sedation started to kick in shortly after. However, the sedation was stronger and moving around was slight challenge. I also noticed  slight wave of euphoria kicking in , similar to what I get from few beers.
Time seemed to fly  and my mind was kind a blunt, however I still was in total control of my body. No blurry vision or nausea. The effects lasted about 5 hours. The whole experience was very positive.
Once I had to go to my dentist and with my dentophobia you can imagine it wasnt going to be the greatest day in my life. So I took 6 mg of Bromazepam  and a painkiller called caffetine(mixture of 325 mg of paracemol, 50 mg caffeine  and 10 mg of codeine). This seemed to work like a charm, the fear was gone, on the contrary I was slightly euphoric, and the painkiller took way the pain.
Since then I have used Bromazepam many times and I think that it is a great drug for certain occasions.
